ModMetaData.name: DBH - Body Size Waste
ModMetaData.author: Local Patch
ModMetaData.description:
Scales Dubs Bad Hygiene waste by each pawn's actual BodySize. Default: original amount × body size × overall multiplier.
[Features] • Body size applies to sewage from toilets, latrines and outdoor defecation • Overall waste multiplier: 0–10× • Body size influence: 0–2 (0 = ignore size, 1 = linear, 2 = squared) • Optional scaling of ground faeces and urine filth • Multiplier preview by body size in the settings window • Pawn info card (i) shows the waste factor and expected waste per use for each toilet type
Settings: Options → Mod settings → DBH - Body Size Waste
